resources.string: Lets your authorised AI agents see and control this phone over Tailscale.

Thumbs runs an authenticated MCP server so agents on your own computers (Claude, Codex, Hermes…) can read the screen and perform touches, typing and navigation on this phone. It only accepts connections carrying an API key you created in the Thumbs app, and by default only over Tailscale. Everything an agent does is listed in the app\'s activity log, and the server can be stopped from its notification at any time.
